text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

CORN TENDER - The CCC said it is seeking up to 85,000 tonnes of U.S. corn for shipment between August 1 and September 10 to North Korea. CCC seeks Number 2 or better yellow corn, 14.5 percent maximum moisture, under Title II funding of the Agency for International Development.
SOYMEAL TENDER - CCC was seeking up to 7,000 tonnes of U.S. soybean meal in bulk for donation to Nicaragua. The shipment was slated for August 10-30. Offers were due July 23.
WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan would be seeking on July 28 a total of 500,000 tonnes optional origin wheat for August 11 to September 10 shipment, a Pakistan embassy official said.

- South Africa's Wheat Board was offering 49,756 tonnes of wheat for sale and delivery before August 31. The wheat is being offered for sale domestically or for export from various depots around the country. The tender closes on July 18.

- The CCC said it was seeking up to 6,360 tonnes of U.S. no. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Tunisia. The shipment period was slated for August 10-August 31. Offers were due on July 22, it said.

WHEAT TENDERS - Jordan is scheduled to tender July 23 for 100,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter or hard red spring wheat or equivalent wheat from other countries, U.S. exporters said. Half of the tonnage was slated for last-half August shipment and the balance for last-half September shipment.

CORN/SOYBEAN TENDER - The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company was seeking 30,000 tonnes of U.S. or Argentine No. 2 yellow corn for arrival in the second half of September and/or the second half of October and 30,000 tonnes of soybean, any origin, for arrival first half of October and/or first half November. The deadline for bids is July 22.

RICE TENDERS - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs will receive offers until July 23 to buy 24,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery, a GEZA spokesman said. Results would be available on July 24.
- The CCC said it was seeking on July 22 a total of 1,780 tonnes U.S. long grain rice for donation to Burkina Faso. The shipment period was due for August 21 to September 5.
MARKET TALK - The South Korean Red Cross said it would hold talks with its North Korean counterpart for more food aid despite a border clash earlier this week.

MARKET TALK - Vietnamese wheat and wheat flour consumption is expected to reach 500,000 tonnes by 2000 from around 400,000 tonnes in 1997, the deputy director-general of the Vietnam Southern Food Corporation said. Cao Thi Ngoc Hoa told a wheat conference in Singapore that demand for wheat and wheat flour had risen steadily from 100,000 tonnes in 1980 to 320,000 tonnes in 1995.

... Private Bangladeshi grain traders urged their government on Friday to lift its subsidy on wheat, saying they were suffering from unfair competition with the government. "We are suffering. That's why we're talking 'no more subsidies'," Syed M. Altaf Hussain of W&W Grains Corp told Reuters at a wheat conference in Singapore. "It's a big problem (for us)."
